2610.12617.title: GeopoliticalQA: Benchmarking Retrieval and Generation over Intelligence Reports
2610.12617.paper_summary: Geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports constitute a rich source of expert knowledge and have increasing value in the current political climate, but their heterogeneity and analytical complexity pose challenges for retrieval-augmented question answering. We introduce a benchmark for grounded question answering over 415 open-source geopolitical and strategic intelligence reports, comprising 5,525 document-grounded question-answer pairs spanning factual, inferential, comparative, and risk-oriented questions. We propose a document-aware generation pipeline that profiles reports before generating questions and validate dataset quality through expert annotation and an LLM-as-judge protocol. Using the benchmark, we evaluate 15 retrieval systems and six open-weight LLMs for RAG. We find that models perform similarly on document-level retrieval, while at the harder chunk level retrieval quality is not driven by embedding-model scale: bge-m3, a mid-size open encoder matches an order of magnitude larger ones and outperforms commercial embedding APIs. In contrast, answer generation remains challenging even given the gold evidence, particularly for inferential and risk-oriented questions.
2610.12617.paper_summary_zh: 地緣政治和戰略情報報告構成了一個豐富的專家知識來源，在當前的政治氣候中具有越來越高的價值，但它們的異質性和分析複雜性對增強檢索的問題回答提出了挑戰。我們引入了一個基準，用於基於415份開源地緣政治和戰略情報報告的基礎問題回答，包含5,525對基於文檔的問題-答案對，涵蓋事實性、推論性、比較性和風險導向的問題。我們提出了一個文檔感知生成管道，在生成問題之前對報告進行分析，並通過專家標註和LLM作為評判者的協議來驗證數據集的質量。利用該基準，我們評估了15個檢索系統和六個開放權重的LLM進行RAG。我們發現模型在文檔級檢索上表現相似，而在更困難的片段級檢索中，檢索質量並不受嵌入模型規模的驅動：bge-m3，一個中型開放編碼器，匹配一個數量級更大的模型，並超越商業嵌入API。相比之下，即使在提供金證據的情況下，答案生成仍然具有挑戰性，特別是對於推論性和風險導向的問題。
